title: Unit 15 Consolidation: The Imperfect Subjunctive and Doña Bárbara
goal: Review the imperfect subjunctive, polite forms, como si, ojalá and the formal -ra, and read a short text about Rómulo Gallegos and Doña Bárbara.
grammar: Review of the imperfect subjunctive: forms, politeness, como si, ojalá and the formal -ra

items: I can form the imperfect subjunctive and use it after a past verb, with -ra or -se.
I can ask politely with quisiera and say a wish with ojalá.
I can compare something to an unreal situation with como si.
I can recognise a -ra form used like a past indicative.
I can read a short text about Rómulo Gallegos and his novel Doña Bárbara.
